description: This file contains a C# test class implementing a grain that manages multiple durable collections (dictionary, list, queue, set) using dependency injection and async methods. It defines various operations for manipulating these collections, intended for testing Orleans grain behavior.

classes.name: TestMultiCollectionGrain
classes.description: A grain class managing multiple durable collections with methods to perform collection operations asynchronously.

methods.name: AddToDictionary
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the dictionary and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: RemoveFromDictionary
methods.description: Removes a key from the dictionary and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetDictionaryValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a key from the dictionary asynchronously.

methods.name: GetDictionaryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of items in the dictionary asynchronously.

methods.name: AddToList
methods.description: Adds an item to the list and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: RemoveListItemAt
methods.description: Removes an item at a specified index from the list and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetListItem
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a specified index from the list asynchronously.

methods.name: GetListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of items in the list asynchronously.

methods.name: AddToQueue
methods.description: Enqueues an item to the queue and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: DequeueItem
methods.description: Dequeues an item from the queue asynchronously.

methods.name: PeekQueueItem
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the queue without removing it asynchronously.

methods.name: GetQueueCount
methods.description: Returns the count of items in the queue asynchronously.

methods.name: AddToSet
methods.description: Adds an item to the set and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: RemoveFromSet
methods.description: Removes an item from the set and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: ContainsSetItem
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the set asynchronously.

methods.name: GetSetCount
methods.description: Returns the count of items in the set asynchronously.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the activation ID of the grain.
